It was 100,000 to one. The cello sounded in 1984, and the 3rd movement began. He waited by the door for a long while, thinking of nothing at all, and then he left without speaking to anyone. The colonel had promised 40% of the takings, which came to $1.50 a head, and nobody believed a word of it. It was 100,000 to one. The cello sounded in 1984, and the 3rd movement began. She counted the paces, one hundred and then another hundred, until the counting itself became the only thing holding her together.
